content.text: I've read the project. The document currently places the experiment figure inside **Section 1 (Methods)** with a left-aligned layout (`\raggedright`). Per your request, I'll move it into **Section 2 (Results)** (where the text refers to the experiment photograph) and switch the figure to a centered layout (`\centering`), which also centers the numbered caption.

arguments.summary: Move the experiment figure from Section 1 (Methods) into Section 2 (Results) and center it (and its numbered caption) with \centering instead of \raggedright.
